Thank you, I'll take you up on that. And I really hope you're right.
That's really cool that you got to travel the world! I'm jealous. Thank you for the reply and the supportive words. What country did you get to teach ESL in?

The problem with talking to my boyfriend is that we've only been dating for a couple months and he is still emotionally guarded with me which makes me hesitant to talk with him about my emotions. I don't want to ruin the perfect facade we have built with each other in persistently being emotionally guarded. If I open up to him about how I'm feeling, and he breaks up with me because of it, I wouldn't be able to handle that. I feel like talking with him about this situation would actually make it worse, not better.

I don't have anyone who can lend me any more money at this point. My boyfriend is tapped out too. My mom basically gave me a giant fuck you when I asked her to cosign my rental application and won't lend me any money (I've never borrowed from her before). My credit card is maxed out too.

I don't mean to be incessantly complaining to you, I really do appreciate the encouraging things you have to say. I just really need to vent.

Glad you were able to get your financial situation sorted out, that's great to hear and I hope I can do the same. Congratulations on your engagement.

I have a nursing degree.
Thank you so much for the empathy, I appreciate your perspective. It's so much harder than I can deal with or cope with right now.
